title: Proper constructible exchange evaluated on a single closed lifted test
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring from the five families $A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\mathcal O_E$ [sk-def-localizing-closure], with the same coefficient topology and small-site universe as [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be a ring, $I$ an ideal, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} A$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $X_Z\to\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ its closed base change, given by a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $M$ be a finite constant-model constructible internal module sheaf [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For an affine pro-etale test $V$ of $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$ with both $V$ and its specified closed-site lift $W$ w-contractible [lem-sfb-closed-lifted-test-isomorphism-criterion], the evaluation at $V$ of the exact-pullback exchange [lem-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-model] on $M[0]$ is invertible. In Lean this is sectionsOver.map of exchange.app, not an independently chosen map. The restriction $R\Gamma(X_W,M)\to R\Gamma((X_Z)_V,h^*M)$ is its normalized model. This includes zero rings and empty schemes; no Tor amplitude or coefficient extension is imposed.

proof.text: Properness over the affine base makes X qcqs and is preserved after pullback to W and V. Pull back the finite constructible stratification and its pro-etale trivializing covers along X_W -> X; inverse-image scalar comparison retains the same finite scalar models. Closed pullback to X_Z also preserves constructibility. Hence both sheaves used below belong to the weak Serre coproduct classes generated by the finite scalar-model constructible sheaves.

Use the covering closed lifted tests V and their specified lifts W=Spec(B), both w-contractible. The lifted pair is henselian, so IB is contained in J=Jac(B). The quotient map identifies Jac(B/IB) with J/IB: maximal ideals correspond and IB is in every maximal ideal. The third ring isomorphism theorem therefore identifies the two closed-point schemes with Spec(B/J), including their maps into W. This also holds for the zero ring.

Apply proper w-contractible closed-fibre rigidity to the localized f at W and to its closed base change at V. Both canonical restrictions to the common closed-point fibre are isomorphisms. Weakly-etale ringed slice localization identifies derived site evaluation with derived sections after pullback. Under these identifications, the composite restriction unit is the unit of the composite inverse image: this is the adjunction-composition unit identity, followed by the canonical projection-preserving pullback identifications. Thus the first restriction is the closed test restriction followed by the second. Cancel the second isomorphism. This proves invertibility of testRestriction on M[0], with its actual coefficient and composition comparisons.

Use nonaffine closed-test exchange identification on the bounded-below object M[0]. Its normalized equation says evaluatedExchange followed by the right comparison is the left comparison followed by testRestriction. Both comparison components are isomorphisms. Cancel the right comparison after using the restriction isomorphism established in the preceding step. By the definition of evaluatedExchange the resulting morphism is sectionsOver.map of exchange.app M[0], exactly the asserted conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem proper_constructible_lifted_test_restriction
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    {X XZ : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper f]
    (h : XZ ⟶ X) (fZ : XZ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ I)))
    (w : IsPullback h fZ f (ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.closedMap A I))
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X M)
    (V : (Spec (.of (A ⧸ I))).AffineProEt)
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)]
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(((Scheme.AffineProEt.closedSiteLift A I).obj V).left, ⊤)] :
    IsIso ((ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.sectionsOver Λ V.hom).map
      ((ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.exchange Λ w.toCommSq).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))
